build_html_serializer: build a DoclingDocument and serialize it to HTML using HTMLDocSerializer with single_column output style
create_mathml_formulas: create HTML output with MathML-converted formulas from FormulaItem using HTMLTextSerializer.serialize
export_tables_to_html: export TableItem grid data to HTML table markup with rowspan, colspan, and header cells using HTMLTableSerializer.serialize
embed_images_in_html: embed PictureItem images as base64 data URIs in HTML figure elements using HTMLPictureSerializer.serialize
serialize_lists_to_html: serialize nested UnorderedList and OrderedList items to HTML ul/ol markup using HTMLListSerializer.serialize
